earlier_exploratory_run.qualification: Status-only RSS reader variant before adding smaps_rollup. All raw earlier trials retained; not pooled with canonical run. Exact initial compiled binary/source-file hashes were not captured. Cache core, fixture, timing body and property tests were unchanged; final source manifest applies to canonical run only.

conditions.fixture_origin: sequence fixture copied from eligible published packing assay 893e6395d1cdadf69f1567483e2423492aba5426; no held code used
conditions.fixture: N2048 compiled terrain phenotype seed99, 2048 neurons, 32768 synapses,17 routes,four microsteps,25 candidates/tick,64 canonical dendritic branches/128 inputs,zero structural edges; nonzero periodic inputs/offsets; synthetic PpoBatch identity holders, no neural trajectory
conditions.timing_scope: Eight calls 512,1,256,384,256,384,256,384. Fresh validate_for, shape clone/comparison, warm metadata/layout packing, base packet materialization or reuse, fresh headers, per-call temporaries and final cache drop. Source fixture construction outside clock. First two calls uncached. Header ages are synthetic 19801..19803 stress values, not an optimizer-step model; no optimizer executes.
conditions.excluded: Production loader/disk/RAM guard, device resources, queue writes/staging/full upload, speech target upload, objective/value preparation, encoding/submission/waits, forward/backward/Adam, checkpoints and canonical state persistence
conditions.timing_order: Two warmup cohorts/mode;11 timed trials/mode alternating baseline-cache then cache-baseline; one process; allocator counters disabled; wrapper TLS check remains
conditions.timing_verification: 54 small varied cases and one untimed full-word equality pass for cached 256/384 shapes; timed results are sampled checksums, equal across modes/trials, not full per-trial hashes
conditions.memory_scope: Two fresh processes/mode, six cohort-only 256/384 calls. Sources held through final sample; not a deployed loader/queue lifetime model. Warm metadata before counters; no timing results derived from memory runs.
conditions.memory_quantities: Packet Vec capacity is retained requested payload. Thread-local GlobalAlloc live/peak counts operation requests; excludes fixture and sampling allocations, allocator rounding and other threads. Linux whole-process status VmRSS/VmHWM plus smaps_rollup RSS/PSS/private-dirty sampled after operations and drop; includes fixture/executable/harness. Boundary samples miss transient packets; VmHWM includes all process history and approximate Linux accounting, not a strict peak bound. Neither is Windows working-set/pagefile admission.
conditions.memory_modes: baseline no cache; cache always-admit; refusal rejects metadata before allocation; eviction allows preflight then refuses all retention from first epoch; cap fixes limit to first packet charge, retaining256 while packing384 temporarily
conditions.memory_release: All tracked operation live bytes reach zero after cohort drop; OS RSS may retain allocator pages. No inference from fewer allocation bytes to lower peak residency.
conditions.admission: Deterministic callback only. Maximum eight entries;256MiB conservative charge cap. Doubled packet capacity plus metadata/Weak-root allowance; charge is a policy estimate, not RSS.
conditions.profile: test; alife_training opt-level3 override;core/world/gpu_backend/runtime opt-level2; debug assertions enabled; not release
conditions.hardware: AMD EPYC 9V74 VM;five visible vCPUs,four-CPU quota,16GiB memory
conditions.uncertainty: Sequential VM trials; uncontrolled CPU frequency/contention/page and allocator history; no formal confidence interval. Memory has only two processes/mode. No GPU or end-to-end speedup claim.

validation.focused: five passed, two manual assays ignored;54 deterministic valid matrix cases,12 invalid fields;identity/layout/COW/expiry,cap/refusal/eviction,header/base sink checks
validation.manual_timing: 1 passed; canonical final raw trials above
validation.manual_memory: 1 parent passed,10 fresh child processes passed
